svg.text: Shared schema across composes / computes / creates and the GTK shell. Reflects your answers to round 1 — still nothing built.

g.text: Same seven menus everywhere — only the accent colour and the lower two menus' content change.
Separators restored per D124: New/Open · Save group · Share · Close, each its own group.
“Download” is still a stub: today's single-format Save-As action, relabelled.
Shared block (Undo…Paste as) is identical in every app; the lower block is app-specific.
D130 (proposed): Row ▸ (Insert above, Insert below, Delete) and Column ▸ (Insert left, Insert
right, Delete) — same submenu mechanism as Paste as ▸, shown open above. Cuts 6 flat items to 2.
composes' app-specific block here instead: Look of this style… / All styles… moves to Format —
so it does NOT also sit in Edit. creates' block: New slide…, Text box, Delete, the shape library.
D · Keyboard state — what UX-01 fixes
Arrow keys move the roving highlight; the menu button itself keeps DOM focus throughout.
Open: click · Enter/Space · ↓ on a focused menu button
Close: Esc, or click outside — focus returns to “Edit”
Move: ↑ ↓ (wraps) · Home/End jump · a letter key types ahead to the next match
Switch menu: ← → moves to the neighbour, opening it if one is already open
Reach the bar: Alt (GTK/Windows) or F10
Submenu (“Paste as”): → or Enter opens it · ← or Esc closes it, focus returns
E · Submenus — the one new MenuBar capability
MenuBar.vue has no concept of a submenu today.
Everything else in the new schema is a flat item or a grouped list (Format,
panel F) — only three items need a real nested submenu: “Edit › Paste as ›
Plain text”, and (D130, proposed) computes' “Edit › Row ›” and “Edit ›
Column ›” (hover or → opens it, Esc/← closes it, focus moves in and back out).
Smallest option: a generic MenuItem variant with its own flyout <ul>,
reusing the same roving-focus logic as the top level — one extra
nesting depth, not a second component, however many items use it.
F · Format, open — empty vs. grouped
Visible-but-inert where there's nothing yet (D125); grouped where there is (D127).
Visible, not clickable — computes has no style system yet (D125). Same for creates.
Grouped by purpose (D127): structure · running text · called-out blocks — taken from the
existing style “purpose” strings in model.py, not yet checked against your eye on real content.
“Ask ai” vs. Tools; the Keyboard dialog's content moves out (D126).
“Ask ai” opens the chat panel with an empty prompt (D126) — distinct from Tools'
task-specific actions. The two greyed items are visible-but-inert stubs (D125)

svg.text: Resolved by the owner, 2026-11-05: File's separators (D124) · empty-but-visible items (D125) · Help's “Ask
ai” and the Keyboard→Config move (D126) · Format's grouping, shown above (D127) · a dialog always closes on
Esc (D128, see dialog-focus-trap.svg) · contrast + dark-mode tokens (D129, see contrast-and-dark-mode.svg).
Still open: Select All — never decided for any menu.
Tools as entirely app-specific is a working default, not revisited (“don't know yet, not too much for it at the moment”) — nothing blocks on it.
Format's grouping above (panel F) is Claude's reading of “grouped” — confirm the three groups, or say how you'd split it instead.
computes' Edit › Row ›/Column › grouping (panel C, D130) is Claude's recommendation in answer to the owner's own question — not yet confirmed.
